assign.outcome:
**The core/Page Overview is a palette** - 29 cards, four bands, and every card is a *picture* of the shape instead of a live demo app zoomed to 0.5.

![](wall-1920.png)

- [The palette](/framework/core/Page/) - band 1 IS the page generator's vocabulary: `tabs vtabs rail list wall grid flush prose crumbs`, then `page children mounts replace route labels`, `shell measure inset region full width render`, and the seven recipes.
- **9 new pages**, one per block word that had none: [tabs](/framework/core/Page/overview/tabs/) [vtabs](/framework/core/Page/overview/vtabs/) [rail](/framework/core/Page/overview/rail/) [list](/framework/core/Page/overview/list/) [grid](/framework/core/Page/overview/grid/) [flush](/framework/core/Page/overview/flush/) [prose](/framework/core/Page/overview/prose/) [crumbs](/framework/core/Page/overview/crumbs/) [width](/framework/core/Page/overview/width/) - each shows the real call running, with the code.
- **`mini(word)`** - [ext/demo/mini.js](/framework/ext/demo/) + `mini.css`: 29 pictures out of a dozen parts and four tokens. No chrome, no text, no live instance.
- The wall draws its own cards, in one seam: the `add()` override in `overview_section()`. A palette has to be one hand at one scale.
- `columns` and `crumbs` joined `methods:` - [api/columns](/framework/core/Page/api/columns/), [api/crumbs](/framework/core/Page/api/crumbs/); `files:` now lists all 29 overview pages.

**Measured** at 1280 / 1920 / 3440: **29 cards = 29 miniatures**, 0 live instances inside a thumb, 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow. All 9 new pages load clean.

Two traps, both recorded in the sheets: a picture named after a part **collided** with it (`.demo-mini-crumbs` on the root wore the crumb STRIP's `align-items: center` and shrank the whole picture) - pictures are `.demo-mini--<word>`, two dashes. And `browse()` collapses empty tracks, so the old two-card *JS, last* band stretched its cards to 659px at 1920 - **no band under six** now.

Left: `core/Page/doc/decisions.md` has no entry for this (a sibling owned the file today) - the record is in `overview/readme.md` and the header of `mini.css`. The `overview/columns` card takes its picture from the central map like every other, so nothing inside that subtree was touched.
